text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, no! 'Mmm~! It's wicked good, 
don'tcha know~♪'"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Is that practice for your reactions as a 
local idol?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've got to practice regularly so it 
comes naturally to me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think it's fine for you to just be the 
usual Tarumae day-to-day, though~

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That won't do. Daily habits get ingrained 
in your body, and come out in your 
split-second reactions!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, well said☆ That's right, change your 
habits and your actions will change. 
Change your actions and your destiny will 
change...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, to change your habits, you should 
first change your environment. At least, 
that's how Feng Shui looks at it—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Geez, there you go bringing up Feng Shui 
again so quickly~...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(No, but... environment, huh. Would 
writing a list of Hokkaido dialect words 
and pasting it on the room wall actually 
work... maybe?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Tarumae, you wanna try it too? Wanna 
get started? With Feng Shui☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
N-No way! I'm gonna change myself through 
my own grit and hard work!
